newsitem.title: USA: Tom Brown sees Presidio Oil deal by yr-end.
newsitem.headline: Tom Brown sees Presidio Oil deal by yr-end.

text.p: Tom Brown Inc said on Wednesday that it expects to acquire Presidio Oil Co by the end of the year, following the U.S. Bankruptcy Court's confirmation of Presidio's reorganization plan.
Tom Brown's acquisition of Presidio for $193.1 million is the basis of the reorganization, Tom Brown said.
No creditor class objected to the confirmation of Presidio's reorganization, Tom Brown said.
Tom Brown said net consideration for Presdio will be $105 million in cash and 2.71 million shares of Tom Brown.

Total consideration would be $105 million in cash, 5.35 million shares of Tom Brown valued at $16.50 each, and the assumption of certain liabilities, but Tom Brown already holds 56 percent of Presidio's senior gas index notes, the company said. As a Presidio creditor, it would receive a portion of the total purchase price, Tom Brown said.
Tom Brown said the acquisition will expand its production, reserve and undeveloped land base, especially in the Rocky Mountains region.
